ticket.title: Publish a period.closed audit event when a period is closed
ticket.why: Closing a period is the one bookkeeping action with no audit trail. Auditors asked who closed each period and when, and today the answer is only in the request logs.
ticket.what: In `src/ledger/services/periods.py`, `close_period` publishes `period.closed` on the event bus with `{tenant_id, period_id, closed_by}` after the close row is written. Nothing else changes.
acceptance: Closing a period publishes exactly one `period.closed` event carrying tenant_id, period_id and closed_by.
A failing subscriber does not roll back the close.
No event is published when the close itself fails.

diff --git a/src/ledger/services/periods.py b/src/ledger/services/periods.py
index 5c1a2f0..9e7d3b4 100644
--- a/src/ledger/services/periods.py
+++ b/src/ledger/services/periods.py
@@ -1,13 +1,66 @@
 """Period service: opening and closing bookkeeping periods."""
 from __future__ import annotations
 
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Callable, Mapping
+
+from ledger import settings
 from ledger.errors import LedgerError
+from ledger.integration import bus
 from ledger.storage import store
 from ledger.types import Period, User
 
 
+class AuditEventFactory(ABC):
+    """Builds the topic and payload for one kind of audit event."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def topic(self, action: str) -> str: ...
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def payload(self, period: Period, user: User) -> dict: ...
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PeriodEventPolicy:
+    """Configurable policy for which period events are published and how."""
+
+    enabled: bool = True
+    topic_prefix: str = "period"
+    payload_builders: Mapping[str, Callable[[Period, User], dict]] = field(default_factory=dict)
+    publisher: Callable[[str, dict], None] = bus.publish
+
+
+class DefaultPeriodEventFactory(AuditEventFactory):
+    def __init__(self, policy: PeriodEventPolicy | None = None) -> None:
+        self.policy = policy or PeriodEventPolicy()
+
+    def topic(self, action: str) -> str:
+        return f"{self.policy.topic_prefix}.{action}"
+
+    def payload(self, period: Period, user: User) -> dict:
+        builder = self.policy.payload_builders.get("closed", _default_payload)
+        return builder(period, user)
+
+
+def _default_payload(period: Period, user: User) -> dict:
+    return {"tenant_id": period.tenant_id, "period_id": period.id, "closed_by": user.id}
+
+
+def _factory() -> AuditEventFactory:
+    name = getattr(settings, "AUDIT_EVENT_STRATEGY", "default")
+    return _FACTORIES[name]()
+
+
+_FACTORIES: dict[str, Callable[[], AuditEventFactory]] = {"default": DefaultPeriodEventFactory}
+
+
 def close_period(period: Period, user: User) -> None:
     """Close ``period`` by writing its close row."""
     if period.closed:
         raise PeriodClosedError(f"period {period.id} is already closed")
     store.close_period(period, user)
+    factory = _factory()
+    if factory and getattr(factory, "policy", PeriodEventPolicy()).enabled:
+        bus.publish(factory.topic("closed"), factory.payload(period, user))
